units.quote:
Each family is producing different
vegetables on their dykes in two seasons which secures their
household food and income generating up to BDT 20,000-25,
000 from selling of vegetables (Table 1).

relationship.outcome_raw: soil organic carbon sequestration rate under CA in woody crops relative to conventional tillage, Mediterranean climatic zone of Africa (average of reported literature values)

context.practice_as_described: Conservation Agriculture in woody perennial crops = groundcovers: at least 30% of the soil between tree rows protected by sown cover crops, spontaneous vegetation or inert covers (pruning residues, leaves), established with minimum soil disturbance
